# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 renderer update. This preview also aligns HarfBuzzSharp generation with the bundled native source.

## Breaking Changes

- **Unicode combining class enum member renamed** — UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now CCC132 to match the upstream name. Rename source references to CCC132; its numeric value remains unchanged.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined was removed** — The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Brings the current upstream renderer into the 4.154 preview line. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
